pages.title: Armor
pages.text: Armor is the main defence. Take any armor to a **Sewing Table** and sew insulation onto it. Insulators such as Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide have their own item tab. JEI has a Sewing Recipes category.

pages.title: Sewing Table
pages.text: Crafted from wool and planks. Adds insulation from items like Goat Fur to armor, held as cold or heat resistance.

pages.title: Fur and hide
pages.text: Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide come from goats and hoglins. Finished sets exist: Goat Fur, Hoglin and Chameleon Scale armor. Hover any piece to read its insulation.

pages.title: Goat Fur Parka
pages.text: One of the ready-made sets. Its insulation is shown in the tooltip. Cold Sweat's Chameleon, a tameable lizard, sheds scales for another set.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.text:
A **Hearth** keeps the area around it comfortable. It takes fuel (see the Hearth Fuel category in JEI).\
\
A **Boiler** warms and an **Icebox** cools. Put a Smokestack on top to make an area livable.

pages.title: Hearth
pages.text: Fuel it, put it in the base. Its range and the fuels it takes are in JEI. Boiler and Icebox have their own fuel lists.

pages.title: Waterskin
pages.text: Cold Sweat's own drink container. Its tooltip shows the keys to drink and pour. A Create Spout can fill it. It carries Thirst purity: purify it in a furnace or campfire.

pages.title: Create diving suit
pages.text: A full Create netherite diving set (netherite backtank, diving helmet, netherite leggings, diving boots) adds heat dampening and shrugs off the wet effect. The backtank tooltip shows the hint.
